body:
Adds `research/selfrep-wearout`: extends the `selfrep-growth` fleet model with random machine lifetimes and recycling credit at retirement. Stylised, all inputs assumed. 8 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok. A post-hoc correction to the fluid equilibrium is labelled as such in the README. The only citation is Jones et al. 2011, carried over from `selfrep-growth`, and I did not re-check it in this run.
